authority_rules: Ambient world summary is setting-level context, not entity-specific authority.

A class-level or world-level fact MUST NOT be transferred to a named location, object, person, group, or historical event unless an entity-specific fact or the approved spine explicitly authorizes that transfer.
Do not invent durable history for named entities. Age, origin, builders, prior incidents, prior owners, institutional history, or old causal knowledge require explicit authority.
Do not invent durable proper names for recurring NPCs or institutions. If a required role has no supplied proper name, use the role descriptor.
Character speculation and hypotheses are allowed only when clearly framed as speculation; narration must not silently promote them into world fact.
Raw readings, field notes, sketches, and measurements are not the same state as a reviewed formal entry. Never describe all records as absent when raw observations already exist.
Future rumors, reports, social spread, access changes, or institutional actions remain conditional unless they occur in the episode or are explicitly committed by the chosen branch.

ambient_world_summary: The Shattered Meridian is an archipelago civilization whose survival depends on maps. Most inner routes are well known, but outer charts disagree, old observatories stand on remote islands, drowned roads appear at extreme tides, and some navigation markers predate every living culture. The world rewards exploration, evidence and careful inference rather than effortless magic.

fresh_setup_repeat.evidence_state_after_choice: Series plus a fresh-setup repeat pair. Fixed result: both repeat readings exceed tolerance, with offsets smaller than the series start and consistent with the series trend at that tide state.
fresh_setup_repeat.cost_or_risk: Not enough time remains to complete formal logging paperwork, so no reviewed record is filed; the freight is delayed by a late report.
fresh_setup_repeat.local_payoff_if_earned: Stronger independent evidence for the anomaly, no reviewed formal log, no milestone commit, and no advisory.

provisional_record.evidence_state_after_choice: The five-reading series alone, with all confounds listed; no fresh-setup repeat exists.
provisional_record.cost_or_risk: The anomaly stays vulnerable to a setup-error explanation, and no new evidence is gained.
provisional_record.local_payoff_if_earned: A reviewed provisional bounded log is filed, the milestone becomes eligible, and no advisory is issued.

must_remain_unresolved.inference_ceiling: This does not establish setup-independence, physical cause, beacon causation, recurrence, other-beacon scope, or advisory-level risk; tide, time, temperature, and setup drift remain competing explanations.
must_remain_unresolved.unresolved_after_reversal: Whether the change is tide-driven, temperature-driven, an instrument artifact, a real beacon drift, or repeatable; whether other beacons are affected.

writer_rules: Do not invent evidence, reviewer verdicts, or record status beyond what the chosen branch defines.

Never claim setup-independence, cause, recurrence, other-beacon scope, or advisory justification.
A static historical mark establishes only a past alignment difference.
Do not commit the milestone in prose; it is eligible only in provisional_record.
Only use meridian_harbor and beacon_ridge; mention no locked locations as scenes.
Stay within 1600-2500 words with clear natural language.
